evidence.title: Introducing Segment Anything: Working toward the first foundation model for image segmentation

summary: Meta AI has introduced Segment Anything (SAM), a foundation model that can segment objects in any image without task‑specific training. By open‑sourcing SAM, the company aims to accelerate computer‑vision research and enable diverse downstream applications.
title: Meta unveils Segment Anything, the first foundation model for image segmentation
